name: 2005 Subaru Impreza S204 STi (inaccurate)
reasons: the uploader titles it (inaccurate) - the source declares its own geometry unreliable, which is disqualifying for a product that matches a reg to the customers actual car; failed on the same ground as its sibling 5eec9521

materials are otherwise sound: black tyres against silver BBS-style rims, transparent glazing with interior resolvable, defined shut lines and headlamp internals - this is a better mesh than the sibling
low cost to lose: the S204 was a 600-unit JDM limited edition, so effectively no UK registration decodes to one

name: Subaru Impreza 22B STI 1998 | www.vecarz.com
reasons: OEM road-spec 1998 Impreza 22B STi in Sonic Blue on gold BBS-style wheels; the 22B is a factory homologation road car, in scope

tyres proven black on a COLOURED-BODY control - the car carries its own blue paint and the tread face is neutral black against gold rims in front34 and rear34; the glTF tire material is textured (white multiplier over a black rubber texture)

glazing proven transparent from the glTF: material windiws is rgba 0.004/0.307/0.364 at alpha 0.602 BLEND, and interior structure resolves through the side glass; light_glass is alpha 0.492 so the lamp lenses are real transparent glass too
21 textures, gold rim faces present in all four tiles

NOTED WEAKNESS: headlamp internals are soft (a pale milky lens with only a faint inner outline) and the tail lamps read as a washed peach - the lens materials are metallic with roughness 0, so that is a lighting response rather than a missing material

name: 1998 Subaru IMPREZA 22B STi Version
